newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: GENCOR SEES BETTER JUNE QUARTER RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: GENCOR SEES BETTER JUNE QUARTER RESULTS.

text.p: Gencor Ltd said on Wednesday it expected an improvement in earnings in the current quarter to end-June and continued to expect similar second-half results to those achieved in the first half.

"I am permitted to say that the current quarter will be better than the last quarter, and that I can see no reason to change the forecast that I made at the half-year regarding Gencor's results for the full 1997 financial year," chairman Brian Gilbertson told a news conference.
Gilbertson said at the time time of the release of half-year results in February that the company should at least achieve similar results in the seond half of its financial year.
Gencor lifted attributable income before exceptional items in the first half to December 31, 1996 by 74 percent to 1,018 million rand.
